text: This report recommends that the name "Sam Ciccolini Lane" be approved to identify an existing public lane north of St. Clair Avenue West, extending between Dufferin Street and St. Clair Gardens. Community Councils have delegated authority to decide street naming matters which comply with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Sam Ciccolini Lane" for an existing public lane north of St. Clair Avenue West, extending between Dufferin Street and St. Clair Gardens.
